title: Trump says he's made 'Hundreds of Billions of Dollars on Stocks' for the U.S., in stream of AI posts
summary_full: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday
